full_name: Hazel Ruth Edwards | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Social Sciences Radcliffe Institute Fellow Howard University
bio: Hazel Ruth Edwards, a professor of architecture at Howard University’s College of Engineering and Architecture, works to improve livability for all citizens and increase diverse voices in the design and planning fields.
